The Ultimate Mowing Machines™

Agile. Reliable. Built for tight spaces.

The Ferris SRSZ1-36, NA delivers commercial-grade performance in a stand-on design that’s compact, nimble, and ideal for navigating tight landscapes. Perfect for gated yards, medians, and urban mowing routes, this mower delivers pro-level results without taking up extra space.

Outfitted with a 36” fabricated deck and powered by a 15.5 HP Kawasaki® FS600V engine, the SRS Z1 provides durable construction, comfort-focused controls, and smooth handling in a smaller footprint.

Features may include:

Compact Powerhouse
15.5 HP Kawasaki® FS600V V-Twin engine delivers proven reliability and smooth power in a compact form.

Fabricated Cutting Deck
36″ iCD™ Cutting System with reinforced construction offers superior cut quality and long-term durability.

Commercial Hydro Drive
Hydro-Gear® ZT-3100® transaxles provide consistent control and power across varying terrain.

Compact Design
Slim 36” cutting width allows access to gated areas and tight spots where larger mowers can’t go.

Adjustable Cutting Height
Deck height can be adjusted quickly from 1.75” – 4.5” in 1/4” increments for precise control.

Operator Platform
Soft-ride operator platform with suspension and padded knee bolster increases comfort on long days.

Easy Maneuverability
Stand-on design provides excellent visibility and agility for trimming and navigating obstacles.

Built to Handle Commercial Tasks
Compact yet commercial-grade, built for landscapers needing power in a space-saving package.
